recipes.title: Black Pepper Chicken & Greens
recipes.subtitle: Glossy pepper sauce · seared broccoli & beans · smashed cucumber
recipes.description: Glossy pepper sauce · seared broccoli & beans · smashed cucumber.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, bite-sized cubes
5 g low-sodium soy sauce for chicken
108 ml water for rice; use packet ratio if different
150 g cucumber, smashed into small chunks

steps: Wash and dry vegetables. Cut broccoli small; shorten beans. Slice garlic and scallion; shred ginger. Cube chicken on a separate board. Toss with its soy and cornflour; chill for 15 minutes.
Rinse rice. Add its water; bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Use the packet water ratio and time if different.
Mix all pepper-sauce ingredients and water. Toss smashed cucumber with its salt; leave 10 minutes and drain. Dress cucumber with its vinegar, sesame oil and crushed garlic.

Heat half the wok oil over medium-high. Sear chicken for 3–4 minutes; lift out. Add remaining oil. Sear broccoli and beans for 6–8 minutes until browned and tender with bite. Add sliced garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Return chicken; add sauce. Toss for 2–3 minutes; check chicken reaches 74°C. Add scallion; loosen with water if needed.
Serve all chicken, vegetables and sauce beside the rice. Cucumber goes in a separate bowl.

tl.description: Makintab na pepper sauce · seared broccoli at beans · smashed cucumber.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, maliliit na cubes
5 g low-sodium soy sauce para sa manok
3 g magaspang na dinurog na black pepper
60 g jasmine rice, timbang bago lutuin
108 ml tubig para sa kanin; sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba
150 g pipino, dinurog sa maliliit na chunks
0.5 g asin SA KABUUAN; para sa pipino

steps: Hugasan at patuyuin ang gulay. Hiwain nang maliit ang broccoli; paikliin ang beans. Hiwain ang bawang at scallion; i-shred ang luya. I-cube ang manok sa hiwalay na sangkalan. Ihalo sa soy nito at cornflour; palamigin nang 15 minuto.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang tubig nito; pakuluan. Takpan; lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio ng tubig at oras sa pakete kung iba.
Paghaluin ang lahat ng sangkap ng pepper sauce at tubig. Ihalo ang pipino sa asin nito; ibabad nang 10 minuto at patuluin. Ihalo sa pipino ang suka, sesame oil at dinurog na bawang nito.

Painitin ang kalahati ng mantika sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-sear ang manok nang 3–4 minuto; iahon. Idagdag ang natitirang mantika. I-sear ang broccoli at beans nang 6–8 minuto hanggang browned at malambot na may konting lutong. Idagdag ang hiniwang bawang at luya nang 30 segundo. Ibalik ang manok; idagdag ang sarsa. Haluin nang 2–3 minuto; tiyaking 74°C ang manok. Idagdag ang scallion; dagdagan ng tubig kung kailangan.
Ihain ang buong manok, gulay at sarsa sa tabi ng kanin. Ihiwalay ang pipino sa mangkok.

recipes.title: Kra Pao Gai
recipes.subtitle: Holy basil chicken · jasmine rice · crisp fried egg
recipes.description: Holy basil chicken · jasmine rice · crisp fried egg.

items: 200 g halal chicken breast, finely chopped by hand
6 g bird’s-eye chilli, minced; use less for milder heat
15 g holy basil leaves; Italian basil if unavailable
108 ml water for rice; use packet ratio if different
50 g egg without shell (1 large per serving); pasteurised for a runny yolk

steps: Hand-chop chicken finely on a separate board; keep the pieces distinct. Crush garlic, chilli and shallot together. Pick basil leaves. Slice cucumber. Mix sauce ingredients with their water.
Rinse rice. Add its water; bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Use the packet water ratio and time if different.

Heat wok oil over high heat. Fry chilli-garlic-shallot paste for 20 seconds. Add chicken. Spread out; sear, then stir-fry for 4–6 minutes. Add sauce; toss for 1–2 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C. Keep a little sauce in the pan. Turn off heat. Fold in basil until just wilted.
Heat the egg oil in a small non-stick pan. Crack in the egg. Fry for 2–4 minutes until the white is set and edges crisp. Use a pasteurised egg for a runny yolk; otherwise cook the yolk firm.
Toss cucumber with lime and its salt. Plate rice, all the basil chicken and sauce, then the egg. Serve cucumber alongside.

8 g neutral oil para sa wok

15 g dahon ng holy basil; Italian basil kung wala
60 g jasmine rice, timbang bago lutuin
108 ml tubig para sa kanin; sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba
50 g itlog na walang shell (1 large bawat serving); pasteurised kung malabnaw ang yolk
4 g neutral oil para sa itlog
0.3 g asin SA KABUUAN; para sa pipino

steps: Pinong tadtarin ang manok sa hiwalay na sangkalan; huwag gawing paste. Durugin nang magkakasama ang bawang, chilli at shallot. Pitasin ang dahon ng basil. Hiwain ang pipino. Paghaluin ang mga sangkap ng sarsa at tubig nito.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang tubig nito; pakuluan. Takpan; lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio ng tubig at oras sa pakete kung iba.

Painitin ang mantika sa malakas na apoy. Igisa ang chilli-garlic-shallot paste nang 20 segundo. Idagdag ang manok. Ikalat; i-sear, saka igisa nang 4–6 minuto. Idagdag ang sarsa; haluin nang 1–2 minuto hanggang 74°C ang manok. Magtira ng kaunting sarsa sa kawali. Patayin ang apoy. Ihalo ang basil hanggang bahagyang malanta.

Painitin ang mantika para sa itlog sa maliit na non-stick pan. Ilagay ang itlog. Iprito nang 2–4 minuto hanggang luto ang puti at crispy ang gilid. Pasteurised na itlog para sa malabnaw na yolk; kung hindi, lutuin pati yolk.
Ihalo ang pipino sa lime at asin nito. Ihain ang kanin, buong basil chicken at sarsa, saka itlog. Ilagay sa tabi ang pipino.

recipes.title: Bulgogi Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipes.subtitle: Pear-soy chicken · crisp lettuce · pickled cucumber · chilli drizzle
recipes.description: Pear-soy chicken · crisp lettuce · pickled cucumber · chilli drizzle.

items: 220 g halal chicken breast, short thin slices across the grain
90 ml water for rice; use packet ratio if different
100 g butter lettuce leaves, left whole

steps: Wash lettuce and cucumber; dry lettuce. Slice cucumber and spring onion. Slice chicken across the grain on a separate board. Mix with soy, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, honey and pear. Refrigerate for 20–60 minutes.
Rinse rice. Add its water; bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Use the packet water ratio and time if different.
Toss cucumber with its vinegar, sugar and salt. Leave 10 minutes. Whisk gochujang with its vinegar and water until pourable.

Heat neutral oil over medium-high. Lift chicken from marinade; sear in 2 batches for 3–4 minutes each. Return all chicken. Add remaining marinade and the pan water; bring to a full simmer. Cook for 2–3 minutes until chicken reaches 74°C and the marinade is cooked through. Keep the glaze loose.
Fill lettuce leaves with rice, chicken and cucumber. Spoon over all cooked glaze. Add spring onion and sesame. Serve the chilli drizzle and extra cucumber alongside.

recipes.title: Braised Chicken Thighs
recipes.subtitle: Preserved lemon & olives · saffron gravy · herbed bulgur
recipes.description: Preserved lemon & olives · saffron gravy · herbed bulgur.

items: 240 g halal boneless skinless chicken thighs
15 g preserved lemon rind, rinsed and finely chopped; no pulp
200 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, no alcohol
2 g spice mix per serving: ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ⅛ tsp each cinnamon and ginger
0.5 g salt TOTAL; divide between chicken and bulgur

steps: Slice onion and carrot; mince garlic and preserved lemon rind. Halve olives. Steep saffron in its warm water for 5 minutes. Pat chicken dry; season with spices and some salt.

Heat olive oil over medium-high. Brown thighs for 4 minutes on one side, then 2 minutes on the other; lift out. Lower heat. Cook onion and carrot for 6–8 minutes; add garlic for 30 seconds. Add stock, saffron water, preserved lemon and olives. Scrape up the browned bits.

Return chicken. Cover; simmer very gently for 25–35 minutes. Chicken must reach 74°C; continue gently until fork-tender. Add water if the sauce reduces too far. Uncover for the last 3–5 minutes if watery; keep plenty of spoonable gravy.
Simmer bulgur with its water and remaining salt, covered, for 12–15 minutes; follow the packet if different. Rest off heat for 5 minutes. Fluff with parsley, coriander and lemon.
Serve thighs, carrots, olives and all gravy beside the herbed bulgur.

items: 240 g halal chicken thighs na walang buto at balat
15 g balat ng preserved lemon, binanlawan at pinong tinadtad; walang pulp
30 g green olives na walang buto, hinati
200 ml low-sodium halal chicken stock, walang alcohol
2 g spice mix bawat serving: ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ⅛ tsp bawat cinnamon at ginger
20 ml maligamgam na tubig para sa saffron

items: 200 g halal lean sirloin, thin short slices across the grain
15 g low-sodium soy sauce for beef
3 g toasted sesame oil for marinade
108 ml water for rice; use packet ratio if different
6 g neutral oil, divided across vegetables
2 g toasted sesame oil, to finish vegetables
5 g low-sodium soy sauce for vegetables
2 g toasted sesame oil for sauce
50 g egg without shell (1 large per serving); pasteurised for a runny yolk

steps: Slice beef thinly across the grain. Toss with its soy, sesame oil, sugar, pear, garlic and ginger; chill for 20–60 minutes. Wash and dry vegetables. Shred carrot; slice mushrooms and scallion. Mix gochujang, vinegar, honey, sauce sesame oil and water until pourable.
Rinse rice. Add its water; bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Use the packet water ratio and time if different.

Use the vegetable neutral oil in a hot non-stick pan, cooking each vegetable separately. Carrot: sear for 2–3 minutes. Mushrooms: brown for 4–5 minutes. Sprouts: stir-fry for 4–6 minutes until thoroughly cooked and piping hot. Spinach: toss for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Divide minced garlic across the vegetables for their last 30 seconds. Finish with vegetable soy, sesame oil and salt.

Heat beef oil over medium-high. Sear beef in 2 small batches, turning, for 3–5 minutes. Add remaining marinade and a splash of water; simmer until cooked through. Check the thickest beef reaches 63°C; rest for at least 3 minutes.
Heat the egg oil in a small non-stick pan. Crack in the egg. Fry for 2–4 minutes until the white is set and edges crisp. Use a pasteurised egg for a runny yolk; otherwise cook the yolk firm.
Arrange rice, beef and vegetables in the bowl; include the pan juices. Add egg, kimchi, nori, spring onion and sesame seeds. Drizzle generously with sauce; serve the rest alongside.

Hugasan ang bigas. Idagdag ang tubig nito; pakuluan. Takpan; lutuin sa mahinang apoy nang 10–12 minuto. Ipahinga nang may takip, walang apoy, nang 10 minuto. Sundin ang ratio ng tubig at oras sa pakete kung iba.

Gamitin ang neutral oil para sa gulay sa mainit na non-stick pan; lutuin nang hiwalay ang bawat gulay. Carrot: i-sear nang 2–3 minuto. Mushrooms: i-brown nang 4–5 minuto. Tapusin sa soy, sesame oil at asin para sa gulay.

Painitin ang mantika para sa beef sa katamtaman hanggang malakas na apoy. I-sear ang beef sa 2 maliit na batch, binabaligtad, nang 3–5 minuto. recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Salmon
recipes.subtitle: Caramelised miso · roasted broccolini · sesame cucumber · rice
recipes.description: Caramelised miso · roasted broccolini · sesame cucumber · rice.

items: 3 g toasted sesame oil for glaze
150 g broccolini, short pieces, thick stems split lengthways
5 g low-sodium soy sauce for broccolini
90 ml water for rice; use packet ratio if different
2 g toasted sesame oil for cucumber

steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Dry broccolini; shorten it and split thick stems. Thinly slice cucumber and scallion; grate ginger. Whisk miso, honey, glaze soy, sesame oil, ginger and water. Reserve half in a clean bowl.
Rinse rice. Add its water; bring to a boil. Cover; simmer on low for 10–12 minutes. Rest off heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Use the packet water ratio and time if different.

Toss broccolini with neutral oil. Spread on a tray; roast for 5 minutes. Place salmon skin-side down beside it. Brush flesh with cooking half of glaze. Roast for 10–14 minutes more, until salmon reaches 63°C. Remove broccolini earlier if already browned and tender. For more colour, grill/broil for 1 minute, watching closely. Toss broccolini with its soy after roasting.
Toss cucumber with its vinegar, sesame oil, sesame seeds, sugar, scallion and salt.
Plate salmon glaze-side up with rice and roasted broccolini. Cucumber goes alongside. Serve the clean reserved miso sauce in a small bowl; thin with water if needed.

90 ml tubig para sa kanin; sundin ang ratio sa pakete kung iba
2 g toasted sesame oil para sa pipino
0.3 g asin SA KABUUAN; para sa pipino

steps: Painitin ang oven sa 220°C / 200°C fan. Patuyuin ang broccolini; paikliin at hatiin ang makapal na tangkay. Manipis na hiwain ang pipino at scallion; gadgarin ang luya. Haluin ang miso, honey, soy para sa glaze, sesame oil, luya at tubig. Itabi ang kalahati sa malinis na mangkok.

Ihalo ang broccolini sa neutral oil. Ikalat sa tray; i-roast nang 5 minuto. Ilagay ang salmon sa tabi, balat sa ilalim. Pahiran ang laman ng kalahati ng glaze para sa pagluluto. Ihalo ang pipino sa suka, sesame oil, sesame seeds, asukal, scallion at asin nito.

Ihain ang salmon na glaze ang nasa ibabaw, kasama ng kanin at roasted broccolini. Ilagay sa tabi ang pipino. Ihain ang malinis na tinabing miso sauce sa maliit na mangkok; dagdagan ng tubig kung kailangan.
